Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
The lamp is decidedly a bright thought.[^1] I will add a bit about [Miss Nightingale](../persons.html#1086) to the introduction to bring it in appropriately.

Yours very truly
C. M.

Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: It had been decided to use an [illustration](../others.html#167) of Florence Nightingale\'s lamp in [A Book of Golden Deeds](../books.html#51).
